performance.verdict: Meta dark 6 days; 5 overdue SOW milestones compound the pipeline freeze.

findings.text: Meta has been $0 spend for 6 consecutive days (Sep 12–17), wiping all leads; prior 28-day CPL was $8.31 on 77 leads.
5 SOW milestones overdue since Jul 23–Aug 31: phone-match attribution, sync cleanup, dashboard, and August renewal scoreboard all undelivered.
GHL shows 74 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments in 28 days — intake is not converting leads regardless of ad volume.
3-day signal (Sep 15–17): spend avg $6.16/day vs $29.60 prior 3 days — confirmed channel-dark collapse, not a creative issue.
GBP actions dropped 69.86% week-over-week; Sep 15–17 show 0 actions, suggesting either a data gap or organic visibility loss coinciding with Meta dark.

suggestions.text: Restore Meta spend immediately on 'BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness' ($346.93 top campaign); confirm billing/payment method first.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been $0 for 6 days (Sep 12–17), confirmed by the daily series, erasing all leads from a channel that generated 77 leads at $8.31 CPL in the prior 28 days. Action: check payment method / account status and reactivate the 'BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness' campaign. Success check: Meta spend resumes ≥$20/day and leads return within 3 days of reactivation (by Sep 21). Sohib to confirm account access before Nacer escalates to platform support.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL intake leak: 74 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — pipeline is stalling before any scheduling occurs.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 74 opportunities created and 0 appointments booked in the 28-day window — leads are arriving but nothing is converting to a scheduled visit. Action: Ahmed/Ali to audit the opportunity pipeline stage logic and confirm Lily's intake workflow is active with the new hire onboarded. Success check: at least 5 appointments appear in GHL within 7 days of reactivating Meta spend (by Sep 25). This is an intake problem, not an ads problem, but it renders any restored lead volume worthless until fixed.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions after Meta restores; 0 actions Sep 15–17 may resolve with data lag — re-check Sep 21.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions fell 69.86% week-over-week and showed 0 actions on Sep 15–17, coinciding with Meta going dark. This may be a data reporting lag rather than a real organic drop. No action taken yet; hypothesis-grade only. Re-check GBP action totals on Sep 21 after Meta is restored — if actions remain at 0 beyond that date, escalate as a separate organic/GBP issue.
